translation: Pallavi (Chorus): In his double-double shirt with its double-coloured trim, they say; in his double-double shirt with its double-coloured trim, they say. He's a real handsome one, he's a gorgeous good-looking man; without seeing that charm of his I can't last even a moment.
In his double-double shirt with its double-coloured trim, they say; in his double-double shirt with its double-coloured trim, they say.

Verse 1: He comes in the dim light before dawn, lies in wait by our house and watches me; that trickster watches me again and again. He comes in the dim light before dawn, lies in wait by our house and watches me; that trickster watches me again and again.

The fellow with the shaggy, tousled hair, he looks terrific. Jentalakidi jejjanakidi jentalakka jejjanaka (refrain). In his double-double shirt with its double-coloured trim, they say; in his double-double shirt with its double-coloured trim, they say.

Verse 2: He called me a rubber doll, that Lashkar fellow; he said he'd marry me, that Lashkar fellow; he called me a jasmine bud. He called me a rubber doll, that Lashkar fellow; he said he'd marry me, that Lashkar fellow; he called me a jasmine bud.

Like Gabbar Singh, he's a sharp, crafty one. A bold one, a truly bold man, a hero among giants. In his double-double shirt with its double-coloured trim, they say; in his double-double shirt with its double-coloured trim, they say.

Verse 3: He brings flowers to fill my hair-knot, that naughty one; he whistles and signals to me, that naughty one; he slips off out of sight and comes back. He brings flowers to fill my hair-knot, that naughty one; he whistles and signals to me, that naughty one; he slips off out of sight and comes back.

A master of play-acting, a butter thief; in his suit and boots he looks so fine. In his double-double shirt with its double-coloured trim, they say; in his double-double shirt with its double-coloured trim, they say.
He's a real handsome one, he's a gorgeous good-looking man; without seeing that charm of his I can't last even a moment.
summaryEn:
Dabal Dabal Angiloniki is a lively romance song sung by Lahari on the SUPERHIT Telangana Folk Songs album (2021). A young woman sings, half teasing and half smitten, about a dashing young man who is courting her. The chorus pictures him showing off in a flashy "double-double" shirt, and she admits she can't last a moment without seeing him.

The verses list his flirting. He hangs about her house before dawn to catch a glimpse of her, whistles and signals, brings flowers for her hair, calls her a rubber doll and a jasmine bud, and promises to marry her. She calls him a trickster and a naughty one, but she is plainly pleased. The comparisons mix old and new: he is like Gabbar Singh, the famous film villain, and also a "butter thief", a playful name for Krishna, the classic charming lover of Telugu folk song, while his suit and boots and his nickname "Lashkar fellow" (possibly a nod to the Secunderabad area, locally called Lashkar) give him a modern, town-bred swagger. Rhythmic vocables ("jentalakidi jejjanaka") and the constantly returning chorus make it a song for dancing.

డబల్ డబల్ అంగిలోనికి అనేది లహరి పాడిన ఉత్సాహభరితమైన ప్రేమ పాట. ఇది 2021 నాటి SUPERHIT Telangana Folk Songs ఆల్బమ్‌లోనిది. ఒక యువతి తనను వెంటాడే అందగాడి గురించి సగం ఆటపట్టిస్తూ, సగం మనసు పారేసుకుంటూ పాడుతుంది. డబల్ డబల్ అంగీ వేసుకుని దర్జాగా తిరిగే అతన్ని ఒక్క గడియైనా చూడకుండా ఉండలేనని పల్లవిలో ఒప్పుకుంటుంది.

చరణాలు అతని సరసాలను వరుసగా చెబుతాయి — మబ్బు మబ్బు గాల ఇంటి దగ్గర మాటేసి చూడటం, సీటి కొట్టి సైగ చేయడం, సిగనిండా పూలు తేవడం, లబ్బరు బొమ్మ, మరుమల్లె మొగ్గ అని పిలవడం, లగ్గం చేసుకుంటానని మాట ఇవ్వడం. ఆమె అతన్ని మాయదారి, చిలిపోడు అని అంటున్నా ఆ మాటల్లో మురిపెమే కనిపిస్తుంది. పోలికల్లో పాతా కొత్తా కలిసిపోతాయి: ఒకవైపు సినిమా విలన్ గబ్బర్ సింగ్, మరోవైపు తెలుగు జానపదాల్లో సరసుడైన ప్రేమికుడిగా పేరొందిన కృష్ణుడి బిరుదు "నవనీత చోరుడు". సూటు బూటు, "లస్కోరోడు" అనే పేరు అతనికి పట్నపు దర్జాను ఇస్తాయి; సికింద్రాబాద్ ప్రాంతాన్ని లష్కర్ అని పిలవడం దీనికి సూచన కావచ్చు. "జెంతాలకిడి జెజ్జనకిడి" వంటి లయబద్ధమైన శబ్దాలు, మళ్ళీ మళ్ళీ వచ్చే పల్లవి ఈ పాటను నృత్యానికి తగినదిగా చేస్తాయి.
